turnaround_reason: SRPT collapsed after its flagship gene therapy ELEVIDYS was linked to three patient deaths from acute liver failure; the FDA requested Sarepta suspend distribution and placed multiple gene-therapy trials on clinical hold. The screener flags it as 'basing' near $16, but this is a falling knife on an active safety crisis, not a confirmed bottom.
bullish_points: Optically cheap on trailing numbers: forward P/E ~6.4, P/B ~1.1, EV/revenue ~0.95, with a still-real ~$2.18B revenue base from EXONDYS/VYONDYS/AMONDYS exon-skippers that are unaffected by the ELEVIDYS halt.
Aggressive cost action: announced ~36% workforce cut (~500 jobs) targeting ~$400M savings, extending cash runway (~$653M cash) while the crisis plays out.
Very high short interest (32.6% of float, short ratio 7.4) sets up violent squeeze potential on any clean safety resolution (e.g., sirolimus protocol amendment clearing the ENVISION hold).
Some insider net buying over trailing 6 months, though most recent transactions are director stock grants rather than open-market conviction buys.
bearish_points: Active FDA safety action: distribution suspended, black-box warning for acute liver injury/failure requested, multiple trials on clinical hold — the growth engine (ELEVIDYS) is offline with no firm restart date.
The 'cheap' forward P/E is built on a collapsing earnings base; consensus estimates almost certainly overstate forward EPS given the halt.
Binary regulatory/safety outcome with genuinely fatal adverse events — the tail risk is further deaths, label restriction, or permanent non-ambulatory contraindication.
Q2 print (Aug 5) will be the first full look at the financial damage; guidance is likely to be withdrawn or slashed.
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings and any FDA/company update on the ELEVIDYS distribution hold and ENVISION trial restart (sirolimus protocol amendment).
catalyst_timing: Q2 earnings Aug 5, 2026; FDA/trial-hold resolution timing unknown (open-ended)
suggested_trade: Pass for now. If forced to express it, only a small defined-risk long-dated call (e.g. Jan 2027 $20s) sized as a lottery ticket on a safety-resolution squeeze — never spot, given open-ended downside on an unresolved FDA action.
key_risk: Another liver-failure death or a permanent FDA restriction on ELEVIDYS that removes the growth engine for good and forces further guidance cuts.
would_skip_if: FDA hold persists into Q3 with no restart pathway, or any additional serious adverse events are reported — which is the base case until proven otherwise.
